shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc 'cat AGENTS.md && cat src/orchestration/onErrorCause.test.ts && ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "command -v lore-query-trace || true; command -v lore_get_ci_failures || true; rg -n 'lore-query-trace|tests_covering' .lore scripts package.json 2>/dev/null | head -50"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md#|onErrorNonError.acceptance.test|onErrorCause.test' src specs scripts | head -80; git branch -vv; git remote -v"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/onErrorCause.test.ts src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "fix(orchestrator): report unstringifiable rejection values" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git status --short --branch'
